wiki.summary: "She" is a song by American rapper Tyler, the Creator featuring Frank Ocean. The song was written by Ocean and Tyler and produced by Tyler himself, it was released on May 10, 2011 as the fourth single from Tyler's studio album Goblin. “She” revolves around a man and his intense lust for a woman, going as far as to watch her sleep and stalk her. While the song features soft melodies from Frank Ocean, it is harshly contrasted by Tyler’s graphic lyrics, which involve themes of rape and necrophilia. Read more on Last.fm.
wiki.content: "She" is a song by American rapper Tyler, the Creator featuring Frank Ocean. The song was written by Ocean and Tyler and produced by Tyler himself, it was released on May 10, 2011 as the fourth single from Tyler's studio album Goblin. “She” revolves around a man and his intense lust for a woman, going as far as to watch her sleep and stalk her. While the song features soft melodies from Frank Ocean, it is harshly contrasted by Tyler’s graphic lyrics, which involve themes of rape and necrophilia. The song’s accompanying music video was released on June 3, 2011. On March 31, 2022, Tyler stated during a Twitch stream of his Call Me If You Get Lost Tour that he originally made the beat for Snoop Dogg, but was unable to give it to him. Read more on Last.fm.
